raidSayLines.line: 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚔️ Wanjiru stood down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and kept walking — 4 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The raccoon with too many fingers stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
the man in his 50s, with a shaved head came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
⚔️ Arnold stared down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
Ivy came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
It followed you. The dog-shaped silence at the treeline is here.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
You don't know what that was. A dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
Fatima came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

More travelers at the treeline — 2 of them — but there's already a petition at your fire. One thing at a time. They make camp outside to wait.
